title: Magma and slag
body:
**Magma**
Careful..

![image: Magma and slag](media/1436282717410037882.png)

**Slag**
Slag only generates in lava pools at the very bottom of the world, and it damages you if you step on it. Breaking it has a chance of launching a piece of raw ore of any kind (iron, gold or tin) into the air, often a few blocks away.

![image: Magma and slag](media/1436506868242452520.png)

Smart players will either build little safety nets around the slag, or just use water.
